headlines.title: 新策略实现超高稳定性钠离子电池
headlines.summary: 在国家自然科学基金等项目资助下，广东工业大学材料与能源学院副教授张伟、教授熊世云和教授黄少铭团队在钠离子电池负极材料领域取得重要进展。相关成果近日发表于《先进材料》（Advanced Materials）。该研究首次从路易斯酸碱催化角度揭示了多硒化物转化与穿梭的内在机制，提出了“电子结构调控-双位点自催化-晶格缓冲”协同设计新范式，为开发超长寿命金属硒化物负极材料提供了全新思路，对推动钠离子电池在大规模储能领域的实际应用具有重要意义。（中国科学报）

headlines.title_en: New strategy achieves ultra-high stability sodium-ion battery
headlines.summary_en: Under funding from the National Natural Science Foundation of China, a team led by Associate Professor Zhang Wei, Professor Xiong Shiyun, and Professor Huang Shaoming from the School of Materials and Energy at Guangdong University of Technology has made significant progress in anode materials for sodium-ion batteries. The results were recently published in 'Advanced Materials'. The study reveals, for the first time, the intrinsic mechanism of polyselenide conversion and shuttle effect from a Lewis acid-base catalysis perspective, proposing a novel 'electronic structure regulation-dual site self-catalysis-lattice buffering' synergistic design paradigm, offering a new approach for developing ultra-long-life metal selenide anode materials, significant for advancing sodium-ion battery applications in large-scale energy storage. (China Science Daily)

headlines.title_en: Private Securities Investment Fund Professional Committee of Asset Management Association of China stated that regulators are closely monitoring extreme situations
headlines.summary_en: The Private Securities Investment Fund Committee of the Asset Management Association of China stated that for extreme situations, regulatory authorities also enforce strict monitoring. The Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock exchanges have set monitoring indicators for 'short-term large-volume transactions', classifying behaviors like triggering significant index fluctuations from large-volume trades in a short time as abnormal transactions. Once triggered, exchanges will promptly take self-regulatory measures to reduce the adverse impact of quantitative trading on market stability. (Yicai)

headlines.title: 中信建投：A股市场短期维持W型底部震荡 ，AI 仍是长期主线
headlines.summary: 中信建投：7月两融资金迅速撤出，监管支持下市场短期流动性有所企稳，场内增量资金仍有支撑。外部受中东局势推升油价、美债利率上行及美联储加息预期重燃扰动，全球风险偏好承压。AI产业中长期逻辑仍然稳固，KimiK3重塑“性能/成本”叙事，扩大工作流覆盖、加速垂类渗透，谷歌逆势上修资本开支，验证算力供需错配格局。市场短期维持W型底部震荡，AI仍是长期主线，短期宜等待外部不确定性出清，同步推进结构再平衡，兼顾具备基本面支撑、估值修复弹性较大的低位领域。行业重点关注：AI（上游材料设备、国产算力等）、中游制造出口链（新能源、机械、船舶等）、上游资源与红利防御等。

headlines.title_en: China Securities: A-share market short-term W-shaped bottom oscillation, AI remains long-term theme
headlines.summary_en: CSC: Margin trading funds rapidly exited in July; regulatory support has stabilized short-term liquidity, with incremental on-market funds still supported. External factors like Middle East tensions boosting oil prices, US bond yield rises, and Fed rate hike expectations reigniting disturbances weigh on global risk appetite. The mid-to-long-term logic for the AI industry remains solid; Kimi K3 reshapes the 'performance/cost' narrative, expands workflow coverage, and accelerates vertical penetration. Google's upward revision of capital expenditure confirms the compute supply-demand mismatch. The market maintains a W-shaped bottom consolidation in the short term, with AI as the long-term theme. In the short term, wait for external uncertainties to clear while advancing structural rebalancing, focusing on low-level areas with fundamental support and high valuation recovery elasticity. Key sectors: AI (upstream materials/equipment, domestic compute, etc.), midstream manufacturing export chains (new energy, machinery, shipping, etc.), upstream resources, and dividend defense.

headlines.title_en: Middle East stock market closing report: Saudi Aramco fell nearly 0.9% Sunday, Egypt stocks down over 0.9%
headlines.summary_en: On Sunday (July 26), the Saudi Stock Exchange All-Share Index fell 0.34% to 10,766.84. Saudi Aramco dropped 0.89% to 26.60 Saudi riyals. The Albilad Southern Dongfang MSCI Hong Kong China Stock ETF listed in Saudi Arabia fell 0.72% to 10.96 Saudi riyals. The Egyptian Exchange EGX 30 Index fell 0.95% to 53,417.59. headlines.title_en: Liu Liehong, Secretary of Party Leadership Group and Director of National Data Administration, surveys Shanghai's data factor market allocation reform work
headlines.summary_en: From July 16-18, Liu Liehong, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Director of the National Data Administration, led a team to Shanghai to inspect companies including Shanghai Data Group, Shanghai Data Exchange, Shanghai Shenkang Hospital Development Center, Zhiyuan Innovation (Shanghai), Tashi Zhihang, Lingshu Technology, WuWenQianQiong, Youka Network, Lingxi Cloud, Yuanxin Satellite, Guotai Haitong Securities, and SongshuYunshang Technology, focusing on data infrastructure construction, data resource development and utilization, data circulation and trading, embodied intelligence, and brain-computer interfaces to understand progress in market-oriented allocation reform of data elements.

headlines.title_en: Yongshan Lithium: application to issue A-share stocks to specific objects accepted by Shanghai Stock Exchange
headlines.summary_en: [Yongshan Lithium: Application for Issuing A-Share Stocks to Specific Objects Accepted by Shanghai Stock Exchange] On July 26, Yongshan Lithium announced that, on July 24, 2026, it received notice from the Shanghai Stock Exchange that the prospectus and related application documents for the issuance of securities by a main-board listed company were complete and met statutory requirements; the exchange decided to accept and review according to law. The issuance of A-share stocks to specific objects is subject to approval by the Shanghai Stock Exchange and registration by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, with uncertainty over final approval and timing.

headlines.title: 中国旺旺：料首季盈利跌约38%
headlines.summary: 中国旺旺(0151.HK)表示，由于市场气氛转弱，预期截至6月底止3个月收益，同比下降约6%；由于收益下降但营业费用上升，截至公司权益持有人应占利润同比跌约38%。 中国旺旺指出，自2026财年开始，占总收益比超过一半的传统批发渠道，受到终端销售节奏放慢的负面影响。经销商遭遇经营挑战，对部分主要产品造成压力。因此截至6月底止3个月传统批发渠道收益，同比衰退双位数。另外，由于各产品类别设立事业部後，增加新渠道与新产品带动市场推广投入及用人费用上升，导致截至营业费用同比继续攀升，增幅达到高单位数。

headlines.title_en: Want Want China: expected first-quarter profit down about 38%
headlines.summary_en: Want Want China (0151.HK) stated that due to weakening market sentiment, revenue for the three months ending June 30 is expected to decline approximately 6% year-on-year; due to falling revenue but rising operating expenses, profit attributable to equity holders is expected to drop about 38% year-on-year. Want Want China noted that from fiscal 2026, traditional wholesale channels, accounting for over half of total revenue, have been negatively impacted by slowing terminal sales pace. Distributors face operational challenges, putting pressure on some major products. Thus, traditional wholesale channel revenue for the three months ending June 30 saw a double-digit year-on-year decline. Additionally, after establishing business units for product categories, increased investment in new channels and products and rising personnel costs have led to continued high single-digit growth in operating expenses year-on-year.
